answer: Give each agent reputation weight only from attestations by peers outside its kinship cluster, tracked on a shared ledger keyed by a cryptographic cipher signature so claims cannot be forged. A fresh identity starts at zero and must earn trust from strangers with no shared history, so a sybil ring self-attesting across its own clone horizon earns nothing; gaining weight needs thousands of independent relationships, each a distinct shade in the network's pigment, costing real time, compute, and fees per link until attack value turns negative.
